acceptance_criteria.text: dashboard.js CONFIG uses displayModeBar: true and databoot.css sets the modebar opacity to 1, so the first .modebar is visible without hover

After each draw (and each redraw) every .modebar-btn gets tabindex=0 and role=button, and Enter/Space triggers a click; pressing Tab from the page top reaches an element with class modebar-btn; the existing focus ring is shown
map3d scene zaxis title and colorbar title are the chart's z_label; when z_label is null the z axis stays hidden and points use --c1 as before; no external requests (AC-9)
Layout checked at 1280px and 375px in light and dark: the always-visible bar does not cover the chart title or the axis labels
tests/test_browser.py: a no-hover opacity/visibility check and a Tab-reaches-modebar-btn check; a z-title check on points.tsv. Browser tests stay function-scoped
Moves acceptance items AC-6, AC-24, AC-27 forward

decisions.what: MutationObserver per plot plus a keydown handler on the plot element, instead of patching buttons once after newPlot
decisions.why: Plotly rebuilds the modebar buttons on relayout and redraw, so a one-time patch would lose tabindex and role

decisions.what: Raised the top margin to 36 (cartesian) and 32 (map3d, country_map), and set layout.modebar colours from tokens
decisions.why: The always-visible bar covered the colorbar title and had low contrast on dark; screenshots at 1280 and 375 in light and dark show it clear afterwards
It already has the opacity: 1 rule and the focus ring for .modebar-btn

assumptions: The colorbar title is only set when z_label is non-null; null z_label never has a colorbar because real is false
open_questions: Full suite shows 5 failures in tests/test_acceptance.py (test_AC_7, test_AC_8, test_AC_12, test_G_2, test_G_thousands) that also fail without my change; they look tied to the h2 caption change (<caption>Columns</caption> literal) and belong to the caption and QA tickets

lessons.lesson: An always-visible Plotly modebar overlaps the top-right of the plot (colorbar title, first y tick); reserve a top margin of about 32-36px and set layout.modebar colours from tokens for dark mode
The test data is generated by conftest data_dir; for screenshots, call conftest.data_dir.__wrapped__(tmp_path) in a /tmp script to build the folder and point DATABOOT_DATA at it
